# Error codes

Every error this platform declares. A code is **append-only**: it identifies one error for as long as the logs live, so a code here is never reused and never repointed (`NOCTUA.md §15.1`).

**Declared is not raised.** The *Raised* column says which of these the platform produces today, measured by looking for the code's own variant in `crates/` outside the generated crate, its own tests and its comments. This page said "every error the platform can return" over all of them, including codes nothing constructs at all — and then stated how many, a number written into this sentence rather than counted, which was wrong the next time a code was reserved. The column is the count.

| `NC-PLUG-0017` | warning | no | yes | none | A plugin reached a bound the catalog declares: a quota, a queue or a count | A part of Noctua reached a limit Noctua sets, so that was refused. | Uma parte do Noctua chegou a um limite que o Noctua impõe, então isso foi recusado. |
| `NC-PLUG-0018` | info | no | yes | none | A write was refused because what it expected to replace had changed | That was changed somewhere else in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Try again. | Isso foi alterado em outro lugar nesse meio-tempo, então nada foi salvo. Tente novamente. |
| `NC-PLUG-0019` | info | no | yes | none | A plugin asked for a key, a timer, a surface or a command that is not there | What was asked for is not there. | O que foi pedido não está lá. |
| `NC-PLUG-0020` | error | no | yes | none | A plugin answered with a result that is not canonical, or that is too large | A part of Noctua gave an answer Noctua cannot read, so nothing it changed in Noctua was kept. O que ela já tinha enviado para fora deste computador pode ter chegado. |
| `NC-PLUG-0021` | error | no | yes | none | A plugin did not activate: it trapped, ran out of fuel, outgrew its memory or refused while it was instantiated or activated | A part of Noctua failed while it was starting, so it was not started. | Uma parte do Noctua falhou enquanto iniciava, então ela não foi iniciada. |
| `NC-PLUG-0022` | error | no | yes | none | A plugin was not loaded: its identity or its namespace is held by a loaded plugin, or its namespace is one the kernel keeps | A part of Noctua asked for a name that another part, or Noctua itself, already has, so it was not started. | Uma parte do Noctua pediu um nome que outra parte, ou o próprio Noctua, já tem, então ela não foi iniciada. |
| `NC-PLUG-0023` | info | no | yes | none | A plugin's command refused what it was asked, answering one of the world's errors in its own words | That could not be done, and the part of Noctua that does it said why. | `NC-PLUG-0024` | warning | no | yes | none | A plugin wrote where only reading is allowed — in activate, a callback or a command declared a read — or dispatched from activate, where no command runs | A part of Noctua tried to change something while it was only allowed to look, and was refused. | Uma parte do Noctua tentou alterar algo quando só podia consultar, e foi recusada. |
| `NC-PLUG-0025` | warning | no | yes | none | A plugin called, where no call tree runs, a host function that acts for the person one runs for: the context, an event, a timer or a surface | A part of Noctua asked for something it may only ask for while it does something for you, and was refused. | Uma parte do Noctua pediu algo que só pode pedir enquanto faz alguma coisa por você, e foi recusada. |
| `NC-PLUG-0026` | warning | no | yes | none | A plugin published an event under a topic that is not one, or that is outside its namespace | A part of Noctua tried to announce something under a name it may not use, and was refused. | Uma parte do Noctua tentou anunciar algo com um nome que não pode usar, e foi recusada. |
| `NC-PLUG-0027` | warning | no | yes | none | A plugin's write named, as the revision it expects to replace, text that is not a revision | A part of Noctua tried to save over a version of something that no version is ever called, and was refused. | `NC-PLUG-0028` | warning | no | yes | none | A plugin called a method on the handle of a unit that had ended — aborted, let go, or begun in a command that has returned — and the call did nothing | A part of Noctua tried to finish a piece of work that had already ended, and was refused. Nothing changed because of it. | Uma parte do Noctua tentou concluir um trabalho que já tinha terminado, e foi recusada. Nada mudou por causa disso. |

## Areas

An area with no codes is a reservation: the prefix is spoken for and the subsystem is a later stage.

| Area | Codes | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| `ACCT` | none yet | Accounts, their fields, and activation |
| `AI` | none yet | Model traffic, agent identity and budget |
| `APPR` | none yet | The approval system |
| `AUTH` | none yet | Authentication. The IdP's own failures; never authorization |
| `BLOB` | 6 | Content-addressed blobs |
| `CANON` | 2 | Canonical serialization: the payload format every boundary carries (§16.4) |
| `CAT` | none yet | The catalog: reading a registry the platform ships. No code yet — the compiler's own diagnostics are located build errors, not identities a log is queried by |
| `CHAN` | 5 | Channels and installs: the manifest an install names itself by, and every name derived from it (§17.1) |
| `DB` | 7 | Databases: PostgreSQL's connections, migrations and pruning, and the local SQLite file |
| `GW` | none yet | The public gateway: ingress, rate limiting, transport |
| `IDS` | 8 | Identifiers: Snowflake, the machine flake, file names |
| `JRNL` | 10 | The command journal and its hash chain |
| `KERN` | 24 | The local kernel and command dispatch |
| `LOG` | 2 | The central log and its shipper |
| `P2P` | none yet | Peer-to-peer transport and availability |
| `PLUG` | 28 | The WASM plugin host |
| `POL` | 7 | Policy packs: loading, validation, evaluation |
| `VAL` | 3 | Input validation, from the rules the catalog compiles |
